question: With mean 0, variance 1 and n20 held fixed, how do standardized-gamma shapes differ in BCa coverage and miss direction, separately from finite-B endpoint variability?

population_contract.gamma: G~Gamma(shape=r,scale=1), X=(G-r)/sqrt(r), using population moments; never restandardize each original sample
population_contract.normal: independent N(0,1) control, not identical to gamma r16
population_contract.shape_properties: skewness=2/sqrt(r), excess kurtosis=6/r, lower bound=-sqrt(r); all change jointly, not an isolated causal skewness effect
population_contract.r1: equal in distribution to Exp(scale=1)-1, but a new independently keyed panel; never reuse old RQ data

randomness.prefix: generate one length4999 bootstrap-mean vector per original/inner pair; use prefixes999/4999; recompute each prefix z0/q; cached t/a depend only on original
randomness.independence: different distributions are independent groups even with the same seed/outer ID; same original/B/inner shares means between percentile and BCa; K and B are not independent population sample counts

inference.definitions: unchanged RQ-M02/M03: ddof1 t, linear empirical quantiles, half-tie z0, mean jackknife acceleration, prior BCa denominator/quantile validity rules
inference.truth_separation: inference receives only original sample/bootstrap mean vector/alpha, never population/r/true mean or variance
inference.no_substitution: no fallback, quantile clipping or adaptive B; invalid intervals retain reasons
inference.tau: B*min(q,1-q) per endpoint; either tau<10 warns, without exclusion or invalidation

metrics.Mbelow: mean_k I(upper<0), interval wholly below truth
metrics.Mabove: mean_k I(lower>0), interval wholly above truth
metrics.Apop: S/(1/sqrt(20)), simulation evaluation only; never used to construct inference intervals
metrics.t_control: K/B copies are display references; actual interval count=R, S/Ase/Apop/endpoint SD=0 if valid
metrics.aggregation: within-original K means first, then independent originals; R400 per seed/N1200 pooled; no Wilson or sd/sqrt(R*K)
metrics.intervals: 99% original-level mean t intervals, no clipping to rate range; zero variance gives undefined decision bounds with descriptive mean retained
metrics.paired_B: B4999-B999 within original, descriptive C/Ase/Apop/T/mean_width differences with original-level MCSE
metrics.paired_methods: percentile-t, bca-percentile, bca-t within original at each B; descriptive C/Ase/Apop/T/mean_width differences

H1.design: independent 2-group Welch 99% interval, each N1200; Satterthwaite df
H1.support: pooled upper<-.02 and all 3 seed point differences<0

H2.support: pooled lower>.03 and all 3 seed point means>0

hypotheses.status: strict interval and separate seed conditions required; touching/straddling threshold or seed failure=>inconclusive. Invalid/unfinished needed originals or zero variance=>inconclusive. Not-supported is not zero-difference/symmetry proof
hypotheses.multiplicity: 2 quantities with99% intervals, approximate multiplicity control, not exact simultaneous guarantee
hypotheses.descriptive: other distributions, B999, endpoint stability, warnings, method/B differences remain descriptive; no promotion based on significance, no monotonicity/causal/limit-B claims

invalid_policy.original: any required invalid inner interval makes that method/B original C/T/S/Ase/Apop/width/warning primary metrics NA
invalid_policy.comparison: missing/invalid original needed by H1/H2 makes that main quantity NA/inconclusive; unrelated populations or B999 invalids do not poison complete confirmatory targets
invalid_policy.conditional: jointly complete original references use conditional_ prefix and explicit denominator; never invalid-as-noncoverage or silent omission
invalid_policy.budgets: retain planned/observed/complete original counts and actual valid/invalid interval counts; stop preserving complete/incomplete cells

storage.original_hash: SHA256 of little-endian float64 C-order vector bytes
storage.capacity: float64 numeric endpoints/diagnostics, compressed NPZ, compact reason strings; no retention of all original bootstrap arrays
storage.audit_limit: saved diagnostics cannot prove actual bootstrap-prefix generation or raw rank counts; frozen source and deterministic references cover that contract

execution.main: once only, no added seeds/R/K/B or redraw on unsupported/inconclusive/invalid/timeout
execution.outer_deadline: standard entry is scripts/run_shape_guarded.py; parent watchdog controls the full worker CLI with TERM at295s, KILL at298s and finish target299s. Worker soft-stops at294s with cleanup reserve, and ignores repeated TERM during final resource writes
execution.smoke: one separately authorized 18cell/R2/K4/prefix19,99 check in smoke namespace;36 originals,144 inner streams,14256 bootstrap samples; no scientific selection
execution.bug_correction: actual code bug only, at most one separately authorized attempt retaining old source/results/reason, cumulative mainwall<=600s
execution.stop: preserve complete/incomplete cells without automatic shrinking/expansion/retry
